news.title: nhow Hotels & Resorts Unveils ‘GAME:NXT by nhow’ Across Europe

summary: NH Hotel Group is hotel operator in Europe and America, founded in 1978. Type: private company. About 18,000 employees (Wikidata). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 85% of its 26 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Madrid-based hotel chain with many Dutch hotels; all 26 roles here are internships, mostly in Amsterdam and 85% without Dutch.

culture.text: Runs around 400 hotels with almost 60,000 rooms in 30 countries, under NH, NH Collection, nhow and Hesperia.
Staff mostly studied tourism, hospitality, business or economics, and work in operations, admin and guest service.
16 of its 26 internships are in Amsterdam, others in Noordwijkerhout, Zandvoort and Hoofddorp; guest service is the biggest field.

open.text: 85% of its 26 internships here don't require Dutch, and 39% show the pay.
Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, and no postings mention visa support.

growth.text: Ranks third in Europe for business hotels.

worth_knowing.text: Its nhow brand launched a gaming concept, 'GAME:NXT by nhow', across Europe.
